newsitem.title: USA: Conn. farmers lead New England in revenues.
newsitem.headline: Conn. farmers lead New England in revenues.

text.p: A study showed Connecticut's farm-related cash receipts in 1995 totaled $484 million, higher than Maine's total of $479 million, Vermont's $472 million and Massachusetts' at $430 million.

It was the third time that Connecticut landed on top of the list in the past four years. Even though Connecticut lost 10,000 acres of farmland in 1995, the state still saw a one-percent increase over 1994's cash receipts.
State agricultural officials say the state's diversity and its proximity to New York and Boston work in the farmers' favor.
